Team —

Quick context: TruNorth Health (prospect, mid-size telehealth provider) is asking to move forward with a Private (on-prem/VPC) deployment. Key asks from their security/compliance and procurement teams: 
- EU-only data residency for PHI-derived vectors (they have EU clinics)

- 35% multi-year discount target (3-year committed spend)

Attached: TN_SOW_v1.pdf (draft SOW) and the early Mutual Action Plan.

Marissa / Laura —

Escalating for leadership direction. TL;DR and recommendation below: 
- ARR: ~$2.1M (3-year committed)
- Technical asks increasing our operational burden: customer-managed HSM + on-prem install support + extended audit window (they want 60 days retrospective logs)
- Commercial: they requested 35% discount; our standard max for Private deals is 20% without VP/Finance signoff.

Recommendation: Provide conditional clearance to proceed to final negotiation with these guardrails: 
1) Discount band: up to 25% with finance sign-off; anything >25% requires VP-level approval.
2) Audit window: allow up to 30 days retrospective logs; anything >30 days to be handled as a scoped professional-services engagement with one-time fee.
3) HSM/KMS: legal to produce a risk statement and require HSM attestation + limited access contract clause (no key escrow by Redwood).

Why approve? Strategic healthcare reference, good margin potential after upsell of managed services, and they are willing to sign a 3-year commitment.

If leadership wants, I've prepared a 1-page exec summary and updated term sheet (attached) to route for final sign-off.

Soojin
